label: nyiso 11 cc-steam rebaseline
definition: BASELINE re-established on current main, same keeper config as nyiso 10 (priced interchange + U9 import-node zone remap, gas_monthly_actuals, commitment), after two main fixes landed: (a) load-shed now prices at each ISO's own VOLL (NYISO $2,000, not ERCOT $5,000), (b) the CC steam-turbine outage-coupling fix (9988a79) regenerated campd-unit-outages-NYISO.csv so a combined-cycle CT derates its steam-augmented block when it trips. Effect on the CC-heavy NY stack: CC backs down ~1.7 TWh in 2023 (CC_REGULAR 29.2->28.5, CC_CHP 13.6->12.7), backfilled by imports (16.4->17.9 TWh), gas total 65.1->63.5. Fuel-mix bands HOLD: 2023 vs EIA-923 gas -0.5%, nuclear -0.1%, hydro -0.1% (at 28.40 TWh budget), wind exact; 2025 on the EIA-930 operational basis (EIA-923 2025 is the incomplete prelim M-file) gas -6.4%, nuclear -0.1%, hydro at budget. Price MAE (demand-wtd monthly LMP vs actual RT) 8.20/4.74/5.98 for 2023/24/25 -- essentially unchanged vs nyiso 10 recomputed on the same metric (7.90/4.52/6.23; +0.30/+0.22/-0.25), and the residual SHAPE is identical: 2023 over-prices winter/shoulder (Jan +45, Feb +12, Mar +13), 2025 under-prices the summer/winter downstate tail (Jan -11, Feb -14, Jun -10, Jul -10). Firm-load shed 0 zone-hours all years; zonal pmax 342/198/270. The outage fix is measured ground truth and was NOT tuned around; the remaining residual is the documented locational/downstate-RCPF scarcity gap, not a volume or availability error.
